## What this changes

One topic per PR. Say which engine/catalog or screen, and why.

## Sources

For every rule, rate, threshold or date touched: the official URL and the day you read it.
(No sources = the PR is a draft.)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run ci:quality` is green locally (paste the last lines)
- [ ] Every new or changed entry has at least one typed citation with `lastVerified`
- [ ] No number appears in prose that is not also a typed field with a source
- [ ] Nothing reads as a recommendation ("you should")
- [ ] The matching `docs/ui-spec/` or `docs/engines/` file is updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, see `DCO.md`)
